006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.xml;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IMetapathExpression;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticContext;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.AbstractLoader;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.IConstraintLoader;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.ISource;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.MetaschemaException;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.AssemblyConstraintSet;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.IConstraintSet;
016import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.IModelConstrained;
017import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.constraint.MetaConstraintSet;
018import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.xml.impl.ConstraintXmlSupport;
019import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.xml.xmlbeans.ImportType;
020import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.xml.xmlbeans.MetaschemaMetaConstraintsDocument;
021import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.xml.xmlbeans.MetaschemaMetapathReferenceType;
022import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model.xml.xmlbeans.ModelContextType;
023import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
024import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
025
026import org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException;
027import org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlOptions;
028
029import java.io.IOException;
030import java.net.URI;
031import java.net.URISyntaxException;
032import java.util.Deque;
033import java.util.LinkedList;
034import java.util.List;
035import java.util.stream.Collectors;
036
037import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
038import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
039
040/**
041 * Used to load a set of external constraints from an XML-based resource.
042 */
043@SuppressWarnings("PMD.CouplingBetweenObjects")
044public class XmlMetaConstraintLoader
045    extends AbstractLoader<List<IConstraintSet>>
046    implements IConstraintLoader {
047
048  @SuppressWarnings("PMD.AvoidInstantiatingObjectsInLoops")
049  @Override
050  protected List<IConstraintSet> parseResource(URI resource, Deque<URI> visitedResources) throws IOException {
051
052    StaticContext.Builder builder = StaticContext.builder()
053        .baseUri(resource);
054    builder.useWildcardWhenNamespaceNotDefaulted(true);
055
056    // parse this set of constraints
057    MetaschemaMetaConstraintsDocument xmlObject = parseConstraintSet(resource);
058
059    MetaschemaMetaConstraintsDocument.MetaschemaMetaConstraints constraints = xmlObject.getMetaschemaMetaConstraints();
060
061    // now check if this constraint set imports other constraint sets
062    List<ImportType> imports = constraints.getImportList();
063
064    // handle imports
065    @NonNull
066    List<IConstraintSet> importedConstraints;
067    if (imports.isEmpty()) {
068      importedConstraints = CollectionUtil.emptyList();
069    } else {
070      try {
071        importedConstraints = new LinkedList<>();
072        for (ImportType imported : imports) {
073          URI importedResource;
074          try {
075            importedResource = new URI(imported.getHref());
076          } catch (URISyntaxException ex) {
077            throw new IOException(ex);
078          }
079          importedResource = ObjectUtils.notNull(resource.resolve(importedResource));
080          importedConstraints.addAll(loadInternal(importedResource, visitedResources));
081        }
082      } catch (MetaschemaException ex) {
083        throw new IOException(ex);
084      }
085    }
086
087    // handle namespace to prefix bindings
088    constraints.getNamespaceBindingList().stream()
089        .forEach(binding -> builder.namespace(
090            ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getPrefix()), ObjectUtils.notNull(binding.getUri())));
091    ISource source = ISource.externalSource(builder.build(), true);
092
093    // create the constraint set
094    List<MetaConstraintSet.Context> contexts = ObjectUtils.notNull(constraints.getContextList().stream()
095        .map(context -> parseContext(ObjectUtils.notNull(context), null, source))
096        .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList()));
097    return CollectionUtil.singletonList(new MetaConstraintSet(source, importedConstraints, contexts));
098  }
099
100  private MetaConstraintSet.Context parseContext(
101      @NonNull ModelContextType contextObj,
102      @Nullable MetaConstraintSet.Context parent,
103      @NonNull ISource source) {
104
105    // generate the metapaths
106    List<IMetapathExpression> metapaths = ObjectUtils.notNull(contextObj.getMetapathList().stream()
107        .map(MetaschemaMetapathReferenceType::getTarget)
108        .map(path -> IMetapathExpression.lazyCompile(ObjectUtils.notNull(path), source.getStaticContext()))
109        .collect(Collectors.toList()));
110
111    // parse the constraints
112    IModelConstrained constraints = new AssemblyConstraintSet(source);
113    ConstraintXmlSupport.parse(constraints, ObjectUtils.notNull(contextObj.getConstraints()), source);
114
115    // create the context
116    MetaConstraintSet.Context context = new MetaConstraintSet.Context(parent, source, metapaths, constraints);
117
118    List<MetaConstraintSet.Context> childContexts = ObjectUtils.notNull(contextObj.getContextList().stream()
119        .map(childObj -> parseContext(ObjectUtils.notNull(childObj), context, source))
120        .collect(Collectors.toList()));
121
122    context.addAll(childContexts);
123
124    return context;
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Parse the provided XML resource as a Metaschema constraints.
129   *
130   * @param resource
131   *          the resource to parse
132   * @return the XMLBeans representation of the Metaschema contraints
133   * @throws IOException
134   *           if a parsing error occurred
135   */
136  @NonNull
137  protected MetaschemaMetaConstraintsDocument parseConstraintSet(@NonNull URI resource) throws IOException {
138    try {
139      XmlOptions options = new XmlOptions();
140      options.setBaseURI(resource);
141      options.setLoadLineNumbers();
142      return ObjectUtils.notNull(MetaschemaMetaConstraintsDocument.Factory.parse(resource.toURL(),
143          options));
144    } catch (XmlException ex) {
145      throw new IOException(ex);
146    }
147  }
148}
